- **Time Series Forecasting Analysis**
  - Developed predictive models using **ARIMA**, **LSTM**, and **Prophet** to forecast time series data with 95% accuracy.
  - Processed and cleaned large-scale datasets containing millions of records using **pandas** and **NumPy**.
  - Implemented feature engineering techniques to capture seasonal patterns and trends in the data.
  - Deployed models in production environment, reducing forecasting error by 30% compared to baseline methods.
